description: nf-core/bactmap samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.0.0 nextflow_schema.json and docs/usage.md. Reference-based bacterial mapping and variant calling.

reference.help: REQUIRED, no default. Path to the reference genome FASTA every sample is mapped against. Supplied by the user at launch.

subsampling_off.help: By default reads are subsampled to a target depth; turn this off to use everything.

remove_recombination.help: Runs Gubbins. Only meaningful for a set of related isolates.

required_user_params.name: reference
required_user_params.definition: Path on the cluster to the reference genome FASTA that every isolate in this cohort will be mapped against. It must be the species you actually sequenced — mapping to the wrong species yields a near-empty alignment, not an error. There is no iGenomes key for bacterial references, so this cannot be resolved from a species name.

pipeline.name: nf-core/bactmap
pipeline.core_rule: Three columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. Taken from docs/usage.md at the pinned tag — 1.0.0 ships no assets/schema_input.json, so the usage document is the authority here.
pipeline.reference_requirement: REQUIRED, via --reference, and it is a plain FASTA path rather than a genome key. The 1.0.0 schema declares no genome/fasta/gtf parameter, so none of the usual reference flags may be emitted.

validation_rules: reference must be answered by the user. Never guess a bacterial reference: a wrong species maps almost nothing and the run completes rather than failing.
Do NOT pass --genome, --fasta or --gtf: the 1.0.0 schema declares none of them. The reference goes in --reference only.
All samples in one run are mapped to the SAME reference, so the cohort must be one species.
remove_recombination (Gubbins) and the tree builders only make sense for a set of related isolates; leave them off for a one-off.
notes: NO MATCHING DATA IN NExtSEEK as of 2026-08-05 — see the bacass note; there is no bacterial isolate sequencing here. This was the closest call in the whole 2026-08-05 census: its samplesheet shape is exactly ours and its single required param is precisely what the elicitation mechanism exists for. It fails on data, not on shape.

sources.notes: Authority for the samplesheet here — 1.0.0 ships no assets/schema_input.json. Specifies sample,fastq_1,fastq_2.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/bactmap input sheet.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/bactmap sheet from a resolved D.SEQ cohort of bacterial isolates of a single species.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for outbreak / phylogenetic work: mapping isolates to a reference and calling variants.
population_priority: Confirm the cohort is isolate sequencing of ONE species before proceeding.
Ask the user for the reference FASTA path; do not infer it from a species name.
final_checks: reference was answered by the user.
Every row is the same species.
